sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', d.date)::date AS ds, SUM(d.total_passengers) AS y FROM daily_passenger_stats d WHERE d.route_id = '127' AND TRIM(d.operator) = 'HTX-ThanhSon' GROUP BY ds ORDER BY ds ASC;
sql_explanation: Retrieves the total passenger count (y) aggregated by year (ds) for route 127 operated by HTX-ThanhSon.
